editorial:
Imagine your job is literally singing to strangers all day. That is the life of the main character in this quirky drama. Everything changes when he sits down for a meal of hot pot and bumps right into his ex-boyfriend. Instead of being a total disaster, this chance meeting turns into a colorful journey of self-discovery. You get a vibe that is warm, musical, and a bit bittersweet, as the lead character tries to figure out if he wants his old flame back or if he is better off flying solo.

The acting is great because it feels like you are watching real people talk and argue. The music is the real star here, as the songs help tell the story and keep the energy high. While the middle part slows down a bit, the emotional payoff at the end makes it worth your time. You should definitely watch this if you like stories about second chances and finding yourself.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the main character realizes that he does not actually want to get back together with his ex. After one last big song, he decides that his new life as a bachelor is where he truly belongs. He says a friendly goodbye to his old love and walks away with a smile. The movie wraps up with him singing a joyful song alone, showing he is finally happy and at peace with himself.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and stories about personal growth.
